packages.title: Governed Service Delivery
packages.summary: Keep request receipt, accepted quote, verified payment, resource authority and delivery evidence distinct.
packages.boundary: Reference state machine; requires authenticated provider adapters and transactional persistence.
packages.verification: Packaged automated checks and independent skill forward-review; no production provider acceptance.

packages.title: Durable Effect Recovery
packages.summary: Record an operation before execution and block blind retries after crashes or uncertain provider responses.
packages.boundary: Single-host SQLite reference; requires provider idempotency and independent recovery readback.
packages.verification: Packaged automated checks and independent skill forward-review; no production provider acceptance.

packages.title: Capability Access Preflight
packages.summary: Turn a capability listing into a review of current connection, licence, permissions and scoped authority.
packages.boundary: Offline evidence validation; authenticating provider evidence requires an adapter.
packages.verification: Packaged automated checks and independent skill forward-review; no production provider acceptance.
